strategy.summary: Reproduce the log_det sign bug by running the PR's test_log_det_sign in cvxpy/tests/test_atoms.py from the buggy checkout. On the buggy revision log_det.sign_from_args reports log(det(X)) as nonnegative, so is_nonneg() is True and the test's assertFalse fails. On the fixed revision the sign is (False, False), the assertion passes, and the value check log(det(0.5*I)) < 0 also holds. No solver is invoked, so solver versions do not decide the transition.

The developer diff bundles many unrelated tests (sign shape, dist_ratio, PSD.residual, Slacks, DGP, DQCP, Complex2Real, etc.). Only test_log_det_sign targets this bug; select it by name and do not treat the other added tests as part of the transition.
The dimension n of the 0.5*I example is not stated in the evidence; the test uses 2x2, which gives log(det) = log(0.25) < 0.
The issue reproducer (lambda_max, lambda_sum_largest, log_det, tr_inv) raises AttributeError from None handling and does not demonstrate the sign violation; do not use it as the reproducer.
If the buggy checkout's setup requires a compiled extension not present on this platform, an editable install may fail; the evidence does not state a build requirement, so needs_build is false.
If an older cvxpy is installed in site-packages, pytest may import it instead of the checkout; run from the repo root with the editable install to avoid this.
